title: Race-pace tempo 2x20min, PM spin 30min
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 15m easy, 2x20min at 160-166bpm (4min jog), 10m easy. Cadence 170+. PM spin 30min at 134-147bpm.
GYM: none.
FUEL: 1 gel before rep 2 (race rehearsal).
GARMIN: run ~130, spin ~30.
STOP RULE: HR drifts over 168 in rep 2 = hold pace, finish at 15min.
WHY: 40min at race HR, up from 3x14 on Wed 21.
